title: Complete Spain (ES) VAT country configuration

requirements.text: Fully configure Spain (country code "ES") in the EU country configuration so it is treated as a supported/ready country in the VAT calculator (correct standard VAT rate, reduced VAT rates list, reverse charge text, and configured=true).
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts, the ES entry has a non-zero standardRate, a non-empty reducedRates array (when applicable), a non-empty reverseChargeText, and configured is set to true.
Spain no longer shows "Configuration Pending" messaging in the VAT country details/transaction steps and the "Start Calculator" action is enabled for ES.

requirements.text: Implement Spain-specific VAT category-to-rate mapping so that selecting a VAT Category in the transaction step can compute an appropriate reduced/super-reduced rate for Spain where applicable, otherwise falling back to Spain's standard rate.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRules.ts, Spain ("ES") is handled explicitly (e.g., within computeVatRateForCategory switch) and returns Spain-appropriate reduced rates for relevant categories and the standard rate for non-eligible categories.

When the selected country is ES, the VAT Category selection influences the effective VAT rate shown/used by the calculator (i.e., reduced categories result in a reduced rate and standard/others remain at the standard rate).

requirements.text: Ensure the Spain configuration integrates cleanly with the existing transaction flow reduced-rate selection (vatTreatment="reduced" and selectedReducedRate), so Spain’s reduced rates are selectable and used consistently in the calculation result.
acceptanceCriteria: When ES is selected and the user chooses reduced VAT treatment, the UI offers Spain’s configured reduced rate options and uses the chosen rate as effectiveVatRate for calculations.
VAT results for ES reflect the selected reduced rate (vatRatePercent in the result matches the chosen reduced rate) and gross/vat amounts update accordingly.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all VAT logic changes confined to the existing frontend VAT configuration/rules modules (no new backend services).
nonGoals: Adding non-Spain country configurations beyond what is required for Spain to be fully supported.
Changing authentication, payments, or invoice persistence behavior.
